## Technical Specifications

### Technology Stack: tauri

**Primary Technologies**:
{{#if (eq techStack 'react')}}
- **Frontend**: React with Next.js 14 App Router
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with component libraries
- **State Management**: Zustand or React Context as needed
- **TypeScript**: Full type safety throughout the application
{{/if}}

{{#if (eq techStack 'vue')}}
- **Frontend**: Vue 3 with Nuxt 3
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with Vue-compatible component libraries
- **State Management**: Pinia for state management
- **TypeScript**: Vue 3 with TypeScript support
{{/if}}

{{#if (eq techStack 'nodejs')}}
- **Backend**: Node.js with Express framework
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **API**: RESTful design with OpenAPI documentation
- **TypeScript**: Full backend type safety
{{/if}}

{{#if (eq techStack 'python')}}
- **Backend**: Python with FastAPI
- **Database**: PostgreSQL or MongoDB based on data structure needs
- **API**: RESTful with automatic OpenAPI documentation
- **Type Safety**: Pydantic models for data validation
{{/if}}

{{#if (eq techStack 'fullstack')}}
- **Frontend**: React with Next.js 14
- **Backend**: Next.js API routes or separate Node.js backend
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Full-Stack**: TypeScript throughout the entire application
{{/if}}

{{#if (eq techStack 'mobile')}}
- **Mobile**: React Native with Expo
- **State**: Redux Toolkit or Zustand for state management
- **Navigation**: React Navigation v6
- **UI**: Native Base or React Native Elements
{{/if}}

**Recommended Tools & Libraries**:
- **Design System**: To be defined by Julie based on project needs
- **Testing**: Jest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E testing
- **Development**: ESLint, Prettier for code quality
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Netlify, or appropriate platform for tauri

## Architecture Overview

### System Design (by John - Backend Architect)

**High-Level Architecture**:
```
[User Interface] ↔ [API Layer] ↔ [Business Logic] ↔ [Data Layer]
```

**Key Architectural Decisions**:
- **Scalability**: Designed to handle growth from MVP to production scale
- **Performance**: Optimized for fast loading and responsive user experience
- **Security**: Built-in authentication, authorization, and data protection
- **Maintainability**: Clean code structure with proper separation of concerns

### Database Design
*To be detailed by John based on specific data requirements*

- **Primary Database**: Recommended based on tauri and data patterns
- **Caching**: Redis for session management and performance optimization
- **Backup Strategy**: Automated backups with point-in-time recovery

## User Experience Design (by Julie - UI/UX Designer)

### Design Philosophy
- **User-Centered**: Every interface decision based on user needs
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance as a baseline
- **Performance**: Beautiful designs that load fast on all devices
- **Consistency**: Cohesive design system across all interfaces

### UI/UX Specifications
- **Design System**: Custom component library based on proven patterns
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with progressive enhancement
- **Animation**: Subtle, purposeful animations using GSAP for enhanced UX
- **Accessibility**: Screen reader support, keyboard navigation, color contrast compliance

### Component Strategy
{{#if (includes features 'design')}}
**Planned Component Libraries**:
- **shadcn/ui** for React projects (highly customizable, accessible)
- **Radix UI** for headless component functionality
- **HeroUI** for modern interface patterns
- **Naive UI** for Vue projects with comprehensive components
{{/if}}

## Success Criteria

### Technical Success Metrics
- **Performance**: Page load times under 2 seconds
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified
- **Security**: No critical vulnerabilities in security audit
- **Code Quality**: 90%+ test coverage, clean code review approval

### Business Success Metrics
- **User Satisfaction**: Positive user feedback and usability metrics
- **Functionality**: All specified features working as intended
- **Scalability**: System handles expected user load
- **Maintainability**: Clean, documented codebase for future development
